findings: Host and inner-root display now use one host-selected query result through generated display inheritance.
Native CSS availability probes remove false missing-container reports across closed roots in Chromium and Firefox.
The WebKit nested-slot size-query failure also occurs on bare HTMLElement controls, with open and closed shadow roots. Light-DOM containers pass all engines.
The library preserves native CSS matching. The diagnostic now says unresolved rather than asserting physical container absence.
limits: The WebKit baseline is an observed platform mismatch, not a passing assertion or a repaired browser.
House layout containers should be established on their hosts. Do not add a guessed global DOM/resize workaround across opaque roots.
Root display defaults must agree with host display; layout-family integration verifies this boundary.
